comments.message: Over 20. 10 runs. Bowler: Shivam Dube. Netherlands: 176/7(rr 8.80)

FOUR! Shivam Dube to Logan van Beek. Half volley, wide outside off stump on the front foot driving, well timed in the air under control past deep extra cover for 4 runs. India win by 17 runs to complete a perfect group stage record. Chasing a tough target, the Netherlands top order all made starts, but none could go on to make the match winning score, and they were always behind the required rate. Bas de Leede made 33 whilst five others fell in the 20s. Indian bowlers excelled with their precise line and lengths. Varun Chakaravarthy was outstanding with his googly deliveries, taking three wickets, well backed up as Shivam Dube's two as India tested out some new combinations ahead of the Super 8s. Shivam Dube was named Player of the Match for his all-around contributions.
